patthana8.25:1.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ na saññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto na saññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: saññojanavippayuttaṃ na saññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto na asaññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: saññojanavippayuttaṃ na saññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto na saññojaniyo ca saññojanavippayutto na asaññojaniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
